b: Celular deitado: as telas de fim de jogo e de pausa cabem inteiras, sem rolar; no toque some o aviso de teclas.

4:3, 16:10 and portrait screens: the gun and arms show in full, resting at the bottom.
Full review: co-op (damage after respawning), Infection, waves, guns and bosses retested with no errors.

Revisión general: cooperativo (daño después de reaparecer), Infección, oleadas, armas y jefes probados de nuevo, sin errores.
